transport.record: Record: the clock runs, navigate freely and drop keyframes
transport.keyframeTitle: Drop a camera keyframe and a look keyframe at the playhead (K)

hints.record: Recording: navigate, then K drops a keyframe at the current time

tracks.emptyCamera: No camera keyframe yet: press K to pin the current view

inspector.title: Keyframe
inspector.holdDesc: The previous look holds for this share of the segment, then crosses over the rest.
inspector.empty: Click a diamond to edit it (the playhead jumps to it), or press K to pin the current view.
inspector.easeDesc: Camera timing over the segment arriving at this keyframe. “Hold” rests on the previous keyframe, then cuts.
inspector.editLookDesc: Opens the Palettes panel on this keyframe: your edits are stored in it while the playhead stays here.
inspector.cameraHint: Navigate the view: while the playhead is on this keyframe, the view is stored in it.

settings.title: Parcours
settings.retimeDesc: Redistributes camera durations for a constant perceived speed (zoom decades, pan, angle).
settings.cornerDesc: Window on each side of every camera keyframe over which the two legs blend (continuous speed and direction).

audio.title: Music
audio.none: No music. Import an audio file: it stays on this device.
audio.generated: Duration {duration}, {added} look keyframes added over {sections} sections
audio.missing: The music “{name}” is no longer in the library.
audio.generateHint: Duration = the music, one look keyframe per section (the current look, to edit), camera speed from energy.

modulators.title: Modulators
modulators.empty: Rhythmic events modulate parameters; they are never keyframes.

layout.editor: Editor view: the fractal in a frame, full-height inspector
layout.dock: Full-screen view: timeline docked over the fractal

linked.camera: Navigation is stored in this camera keyframe.
linked.look: Palette and look settings are stored in this keyframe.

palettes.title: Palettes
palettes.empty: No saved palette yet. Save some in the Palettes panel.
palettes.pasteTitle: Paste the copied look onto this keyframe (Ctrl/Cmd+V)

view.zoomIn: Zoom the timeline in (+, or wheel)
view.fit: Show the whole parcours (Shift+Z, or double-click the ruler)
view.follow: Auto-scroll: keep the playhead centred during playback (F)

markers.add: Add a marker at the playhead (M). Double-click to rename, empty name to delete.

double.splitDesc: Double keyframe: an arrival side (where the previous plan ends) and a departure side (where the next one starts), with a cut between them. The arrival side starts as the previous keyframe: the plan holds still, then cuts.
double.mergeDesc: Back to a single keyframe: the arrival side is removed.
double.sideInDesc: Left side: the state the previous plan glides to. Your edits go to this side.
double.sideOutDesc: Right side: the state the next plan leaves from. Your edits go to this side.

batch.title: {count} keyframes selected
batch.hint: Shift+click adds a keyframe, Shift+drag draws a box, Ctrl/Cmd+A takes the whole track. Dragging moves the group.

places.title: Places
places.empty: No saved scene. Save scenes to find them here.

bin.tileTitle: {name} — drag onto the timeline, or click to apply to the selected keyframes

empty.place: No place. Add the current view or pick from your saved scenes.
empty.look: No palette. Add the current look or pick from your palettes.

selectFirst.place: Select a camera keyframe first, or drag the place onto the timeline.
selectFirst.look: Select a look keyframe first, or drag the palette onto the timeline.

fill.title: Fill from markers
fill.hint: Pins one keyframe per marker with the items of this collection. With a loop range (I / O), only its markers are used.

bin.addSceneTitle: Add the palette of the scene “{name}”
